title: Quantitative in vivo assessment of amyloid-beta phagocytic capacity in an Alzheimer’s disease mouse model
protocol: Warm the MeX04 working solution (2 mg/mL) in a 37°C water bath for 5 min before injection.
Weigh the AD transgenic mice and intraperitoneally inject MeX04 working solution at 10 mg/kg.
Euthanize mice using isoflurane 3 hours after MeX04 injection.
Perfuse mice with 20 mL ice-cold PBS.
Dissect the region(s) of interest in ice-cold PBS.
Prepare enzyme dissociation solution by adding 0.004 g l-cysteine, 100 U papain, and 700 U DNaseI into 20 mL working aCSF solution.
Prewarm the enzyme dissociation solution in a 37°C water bath for 5 minutes.
Mince the brain tissue into small pieces on a petri dish.
Transfer minced brain tissue to a 50-mL falcon tube with 20 mL enzyme dissociation solution.
Incubate in a 37°C water bath with constant shaking for 10 minutes.
Very gently pass the tissue through a 20-gauge needle 3 times.
Return the tubes to the 37°C water bath for an additional 30 minutes of digestion.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 7 mL working aCSF solution.
Add 3 mL isotonic Percoll and mix well by inverting 10 times.
Gently add 2 mL working aCSF on top of the mixture containing 30% Percoll.
Centrifuge at 800 × g at 4°C for 15 minutes with the slowest acceleration and zero deceleration.
Use a P1000 pipette to gently remove the myelin debris layer trapped between the aCSF and 30% Percoll.
Aspirate all supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μl of ice-cold DMEM/F12 with 10% heat-inactivated FBS.
Aliquot 5 μl cell suspension and inspect cell viability, number, and singlet by hemocytometer.
Stain the cell suspension (200 μl) with CD11b-APC (1:200) and CD45-FITC (1:200) for 45 min at 4°C with rotation.
Prepare unstained controls using AD transgenic model mice and non-transgenic wild-type mice to serve as fluorescence-minus-one controls.
Wash the cells with 1 ml DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS and centrifuge at 800 × g at 4°C for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells in 500 μl DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS.
Use a non-transgenic mice brain sample to set a negative signal for MeX04 and an unstained control sample to set a negative signal for CD11b and CD45.
Proceed with the samples and record the MeX04 signals of 10,000 microglia.
Analyze the data using FlowJo to obtain the proportion of MeX04+ microglia (proportion of Aβ phagocytic microglia).
Determine the mean fluorescence intensity of MeX04 (Aβ phagocytic capacity).
